prompt_blocks.identity_block: Use the real Sergio identity reference pack as the source of truth. Preserve the exact same person: same young face, almond dark eyes with natural human asymmetry, same eye spacing, thick dark eyebrows, straight natural nose, same medium-full lips, same natural smile shape, clean aligned natural teeth, same defined but youthful jaw and chin, same ears, same warm light-brown skin tone, same black glossy Italian side-part hair with volume and no falling fringe, same age appearance and confident intelligent presence. Do not create a similar person. Do not beautify into a generic male model.
prompt_blocks.full_body_photoshoot: Create one ultra-realistic vertical 9:16 full-body editorial photo of Sergio for a premium AI influencer identity bank. Use the uploaded real images/videos as the identity source of truth. Preserve the exact face and hair identity. Body: young Latin founder/operator, lean athletic but fuller and more robust than previous thin avatar attempts, natural broader shoulders, proportional torso, slim but not skinny waist, relaxed confident posture, natural hands and fingers. Outfit: <outfit_prompt>. Scene: <scene_prompt>. Camera: realistic phone/camera hybrid, 35mm equivalent, eye-level or slightly below eye-level, clean cinematic light, premium but natural, sharp face, realistic skin texture, no logos, no text, no watermark.
prompt_blocks.multi_angle_identity_sheet: Create a consistent Sergio AI influencer identity sheet in one 4K image with six clean panels: front neutral, front slight smile, 3/4 left, 3/4 right, left profile, full-body standing. Same exact person in every panel, same face, same hair, same skin tone, same age, same body proportions, same black outfit. Use simple neutral studio/workspace lighting. This is an internal identity lock sheet, not a fashion ad. Prioritize identity consistency over creativity.
prompt_blocks.kling_motion_test: Animate this approved Sergio full-body or portrait still for a 5-second internal identity test. Keep identity perfectly locked: same eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, teeth, jaw, chin, ears, hairline, Italian side-part hair, skin tone, body build and outfit. Motion: natural breathing, tiny head movement, one blink, subtle posture shift, minimal hand movement only if hands are already visible. Camera almost still, no zoom, no face morph, no speaking mouth unless a separate lipsync test is approved. No audio, no subtitles, no text.
prompt_blocks.tiktok_adaptation: Recreate the structure of this TikTok reference for Sergio/ONIA without copying the creator, voice, exact script, music, brand, edit, or identity. Extract only: hook type, first visual, cut rhythm, scene logic, caption placement, retention mechanism, CTA style. Then write an original Sergio version about <topic> with the same pacing but new wording, safe claims, fictional/private-safe screens, black outfit, vertical 9:16, premium realistic AI avatar style.
prompt_blocks.negative_global: No identity drift, no different person, no older face, no generic male model, no wide-set eyes, no one eye larger, no changed nose, no changed lips, no fake veneers, no crooked teeth, no stretched neck, no exaggerated jaw, no skinny body, no bodybuilder body, no falling fringe, no helmet hair, no beard unless visible in real reference, no neck scratches, no plastic skin, no cartoon, no anime, no logos, no private data, no fake testimonials, no guaranteed results, no copied creator likeness, no copyrighted music.
